new_threads.name: The treasure map
new_threads.reason: The party is following a map whose marked locations they do not recognize, and the treasure has not been found.

new_threads.name: The Clurichen of the riverbanks
new_threads.reason: Reginald warned of a trickster creature that comes into town nightly. Sir Phidipaldi's claims about it were shown wrong, but what it is up to remains unknown.

new_threads.name: The black dragon near Brandonsford
new_threads.reason: The dragon, Eric's 1000-gold bounty, George's account and Gill's sons' hunt are all one danger and pursuit, and none of it is settled.

new_threads.name: Hiring Lady Hilda
new_threads.reason: Lady Hilda offered to join a paid party against the dragon, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would come back for her services after seeing the Reeve (beat_10).

new_threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer
new_threads.reason: Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire, and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.

new_threads.name: The missing shipments to Brandonsford
new_threads.reason: Bentley's shipment never arrived and nothing has come into town for months. Why remains unknown, and Wayman asked whether anyone had gone after it.

new_threads.name: Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric the Reeve
new_threads.reason: Sir Phidipaldi insulted the bounty-giver and challenged him to a duel. Eric declined, but the ill will and Bentley's ruling sending Phidipaldi to the Golden Egg leave relations strained.

new_threads.name: Shamus the mule
new_threads.reason: Gill offered the mule for 100 gold, and Dunk asked about trading work for it. Dunk is sleeping on the offer.

new_threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
new_threads.reason: A superb mithril shirt that Warwick refuses to sell is a potential prize for the party.

new_threads.name: Quinn's vanishing ale
new_threads.reason: Quinn's stock disappears nightly and he blames Bentley. Sir Phidipaldi agreed to a 100-gold fake-shipment plan that has not yet been carried out.

standalone_beats.reason: Brandonsford has no real law enforcement, only a night watch, which is useful background but tied to no thread.
The party gained entry to town; this was consequential but left nothing open.
The party learned the lodging terms at the Clumsy Fox.
Ingrid is where to get potions; this is a local resource not tied to any thread.

shared_subjects.subject: Eric the Reeve's 1000-gold dragon bounty
shared_subjects.reason: The bounty is acted on by hunting the dragon, though the quarrel puts the party's standing with its giver at risk.

shared_subjects.subject: Whether black dragons exist
shared_subjects.reason: This is knowledge about the dragon itself, even though Phidipaldi's false claim sparked the quarrel and invoked the Clurichen.

shared_subjects.subject: Lady Hilda's offer to join for pay
shared_subjects.reason: The offer has its own thread, which serves the dragon hunt.

shared_subjects.subject: No shipments reaching town
shared_subjects.reason: The lack of shipments is the missing-shipment thread's question, and Quinn's fake-shipment plan only exploits it.

shared_subjects.subject: Killing the dragon as work to trade for Shamus
shared_subjects.reason: Gill named the dragon as the big work needed when Dunk asked about trading work for the mule.
